drafted_from: tool:finish-what-is-waiting-on-me's own row and test/waiting-records.test.mjs, whose runs answered the values shown here
start_here: Say to your AI: "Mark record:waiting-on-you:sample-signed-form done under request key sample-completion." It runs tool:finish-what-is-waiting-on-me, writes the declared completion on that same record and reads it back.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it changes only the waiting record you name, by its source's declared completion.
instructions: 1. Take the card ids from tool:read-what-is-waiting-on-me and pick a fresh request_key.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:finish-what-is-waiting-on-me and { ids, request_key }.
3. Read completed and changed; a retry with the same key answers changed 0 and changes nothing.
4. Confirm with tool:verify-waiting-on-me-completion and the same ids and request_key.

worked_examples.title: An ask is marked done, and a retry is safe
worked_examples.ask: I signed the form; mark it done.
worked_examples.given: From test/waiting-records.test.mjs: one record:waiting-on-you row with status Waiting.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answered {"completed":["record:waiting-on-you:sample"],"changed":1}; the same call again answered changed 0, and the record now reads status "Done".
